description: This file contains test functions for the Mattermost server, specifically testing import functionalities such as bulk import, processing import data, attachment handling, and import deletion. It includes setup, validation, and error handling tests related to import data processing.

methods.name: checkPreference
methods.description: Verifies that a user preference matches the expected value for a given category and name.

methods.name: checkNotifyProp
methods.description: Checks that a user's notification property matches the expected value.

methods.name: checkError
methods.description: Asserts that the provided AppError is not nil, indicating an error occurred.

methods.name: checkNoError
methods.description: Asserts that the provided AppError is nil, indicating no error occurred.

methods.name: AssertAllPostsCount
methods.description: Validates that the total post count for a team matches the expected count after a change.

methods.name: AssertChannelCount
methods.description: Checks that the number of channels of a specific type matches the expected count.

methods.name: TestImportImportLine
methods.description: Unit test for importing individual lines with various types, validating error handling for invalid or nil data.

methods.name: TestStopOnError
methods.description: Tests the behavior of the stopOnError function with different error scenarios.

methods.name: TestImportBulkImport
methods.description: Tests the bulk import process with valid data, invalid JSON, missing version, and large input handling.

methods.name: TestImportBulkImportWithAttachments
methods.description: Tests bulk import with attachments, verifying correct processing and attachment handling.

methods.name: TestImportBulkImportWithNestedJsonl
methods.description: Tests bulk import with nested JSONL files to validate nested import processing.

methods.name: TestDeleteImport
methods.description: Tests the deletion of import files, ensuring proper removal and idempotency.

methods.name: GetAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves file info for a user from the store.

methods.name: AssertFileIdsInPost
methods.description: Checks that files are correctly associated with a post.

methods.name: TestProcessAttachmentPaths
methods.description: Unit tests for processing attachment paths, including validation, path cleaning, and error cases.

methods.name: TestProcessAttachments
methods.description: Tests processing of attachments for posts, direct posts, user avatars, and emojis, including with file maps.

methods.name: BenchmarkBulkImport
methods.description: Benchmark test for bulk import performance with large data.
